description: Korean gift tax on living rent-free in a family member's property (상증법 제37조①): benefit = property value × 2% a year, summed over 5 years discounted at 10% (factor ≈ 3.7908); a gift only when it reaches 100M KRW (property ≈ 1.319B KRW) and not when living together with the owner. Also free use as loan collateral (제37조②): loan × 4.6% − interest paid, a gift from 10M KRW a year. Returns both benefits and gift tax.

coResiding.description: The user lives together with the owner in that home

collateralInterest.description: Interest actually paid on that loan per year (KRW)

collateralLoan.description: Loan borrowed using the property as free collateral (KRW)

propertyValue.description: Market value of the property (or standard value if none) (KRW)
